text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Osaka Hai, and Satono Diamond is calmly preparing for the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she's taken aback when she comes across Kitasan Black in the paddock. She has a completely new aura about her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For just a moment, Satono Diamond falters in the face of Kitasan Black's intensity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She reproaches herself by quietly repeating to herself that she won't lose, and regains her nerve.
